unique.reason: Unique removes the second a and preserves first occurrence order.

count.reason: Count returns one integer equal to the source population length three, including duplicates.

concat.reason: Concat combines the literal prefix with each unique value in document order.

merge.reason: Lexical ascending merge joins the unique values with the explicit comma delimiter.

reason: Expected values are independently derived from ordered literal populations; status/error propagation and runtime execution remain separate.
